lens.message:
Here's the shift: Zypherion is now the decided analytics database — adopted on a 15x columnar speedup, with migration starting Q3 2026. Analytics work now starts from that as given rather than as an open choice. It changes how we approach which database the analytics stack runs on, migration planning against Q3 2026, and the performance bar for analytics queries.

Quinton said it plainly: "It handles columnar queries 15x faster than our current setup. The migration starts next quarter."

One place to check it — the decision note itself, 'Key decisions':

As written: a record of what was announced — Database: Zypherion for analytics; Performance: 15x improvement on columnar queries; Timeline: Migration starts Q3 2026.

Through the lens: the operating baseline. Analytics documents now start from Zypherion as given — 15x is the number to match or beat, Q3 2026 is the date other plans schedule around, and departing from any of the three lines is what needs justifying.

Right lens?

On reach, honestly: this lands on one document right now — this decision note. The stream has no other documents yet, so there is nothing to apply it across. When analytics or migration documents show up, this is the reading they get.
